product.guide_step_1_body: Define the garment type, fabric, colors, and quantity so the workshop can advise the right setup for wholesale or retail production.
product.guide_step_2_body: The workshop confirms the size chart, print or embroidery details, sample timing, and sends a quotation matching the approved setup.
product.guide_step_3_body: After sample approval or mockup confirmation, the order is scheduled for production and tracked across each stage.
product.guide_step_4_body: The workshop checks finishing quality, packs by size or receiving point, and delivers to retail buyers, agencies, or corporate clients.
product.guide_note_1: Confirm size charts, logo placement, and per-color quantities before approving the final quotation.
product.guide_note_2: For wholesale orders, align packaging rules, labels, and split-shipment timing in advance if needed.
product.guide_note_3: If you need a rush sample or pattern adjustment, note it clearly so the technical team can prioritize it.
